title: The Afternoon Boats
story: On a cold, calm Festival Eve afternoon, five rowers in the lantern flotilla took the boatyard's rental rowboats out to rehearse, each to a different spot on the route. Felix keeps those boats in the water this late only for the flotilla. High tide had the causeway under water, so the only way to the Point was by boat. Felix rowed too, so he can vouch for his own trip and nobody else's. Who rowed which boat where, and when?

question.text: Who rowed out to Thimble Point?

texts: Of the rower bound for Gull Rock and the rower who pushed off at 3:30 p.m., one took out the Puffin and the other took out the Minnow.
Of Nico and the rower who pushed off at 3:30 p.m., one took out the Teacup and the other took out the Minnow.
The rower who pushed off at 3:00 p.m. is either Felix or Imani.
Felix pushed off at neither 2:00 p.m. nor 2:30 p.m.
Oscar took out neither the Minnow nor the Puffin.
The rower who pushed off at 3:30 p.m. rowed to neither East Cove nor the Narrows.
The rower in the Skipjack pushed off at neither 2:00 p.m. nor 3:30 p.m.
The rower who pushed off at 2:30 p.m. is neither Oscar nor Imani.
Felix pushed off earlier than Teddy.
The rower bound for Seal Ledge is either Oscar or Imani.
The rower bound for the Narrows pushed off earlier than the rower bound for East Cove.
Of Nico and Felix, one rowed to Gull Rock and the other rowed to the Narrows.

SUPPOSE TEST: try Imani with the Minnow.
